### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Compute AlphaGo Zero policy logits over action space and bounded scalar value predictions in [-1, 1] from shared convolutional trunk representations.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def alphago_l02_policy_value_heads(features: list, w_pi: list, b_pi: list, w_v: list, b_v: list) -> dict:
    feat = np.array(features, dtype=float)
    pi_logits = np.dot(feat, np.array(w_pi, dtype=float)) + np.array(b_pi, dtype=float)
    v_raw = np.dot(feat, np.array(w_v, dtype=float)) + np.array(b_v, dtype=float)
    return {'policy_logits': np.round(pi_logits, 6).tolist(), 'value': round(float(np.squeeze(np.tanh(v_raw))), 6)}
```
